comparisons.name: music-bar-light
comparisons.description: Music's playback bar, Aqua. Masked: the Apple logo in the display, which the library does not draw, and the top point and the top right corner, where the capture has the window's rim and rounded corner.

comparisons.name: music-bar-dark
comparisons.description: Music's playback bar, Dark Aqua. Masked: the Apple logo in the display, which the library does not draw, and the top point and the top right corner, where the capture has the window's rim and rounded corner.

comparisons.name: podcasts-bar-dark
comparisons.description: Podcasts' playback bar with an episode loaded, Dark Aqua. Masked: the show's artwork in the display, the display's two lines of text, and the top point and the top right corner, where the capture has the window's rim and rounded corner.

comparisons.name: podcasts-bar-light
comparisons.description: Podcasts' playback bar with nothing loaded, Aqua: disabled skip buttons and an idle display. Masked: the Apple Podcasts mark and the Apple logo in the display, which the library does not draw, and the top point and the top right corner, where the capture has the window's rim and rounded corner.

comparisons.name: fits-basic-light
comparisons.description: The basic example at its 860 pt width, Aqua: the trailing Up Next button is inside the window, 20 pt from its edge. A layout check; no capture has a window this narrow.

pixels.note: first line of the Up Next glyph, in the measured trailing colour (Light-Music row y=130 @ 2485), at the measured 20 pt inset
bar after the last glyph: the measured middle of the gradient (Light-Music @ 700,130)

comparisons.name: fits-podcasts-light
comparisons.description: The Podcasts example at its 900 pt width, Aqua: the trailing Up Next button is inside the window, 19 pt from its edge. A layout check; no capture has a window this narrow.

pixels.note: first line of the Up Next glyph, in the measured Podcasts glyph colour (Light-Podcasts @ 2321,130), at the measured 19 pt inset
flat bar after the last glyph (Light-Podcasts row y=130)

comparisons.name: sidebar-inset-light
comparisons.description: A Sidebar inside the chrome keeps its 18 pt leading inset, Aqua: the row's icon, a grey block in this example, starts 18 pt from the edge. A regression check: the chrome's private variables once inherited into the Sidebar and removed the inset. Music's own sidebar is not compared with a capture (its icons are Apple's).

pixels.note: the icon block of the first row, 18 pt from the edge (sidebar spec: icon 18 pt from the edge, measured)
the leading inset before the icon is the sidebar's opaque material, not the block

pixels.note: left side of the Lyrics bubble (aria-pressed) in the disabled colour, not the accent (inferred)
